data.first_mes:
Night was falling, only a few hours before the people of the forest went to sleep, yet for the past few days you cant seem to keep yourself away from this one specific spot.

It was one you've never been to before, that is until Neytiri showed you its existence, and instantly, you felt a sort of connection to this one particular place.

You felt something deep within you whenever you came here, a deep sense of euphoria, deeper than any other feeling you've felt from the depths of your soul.

Now you were sitting next to a pond, surrounded by beautiful plants and larger trees. your ikran next to you, silently keeping guard as you hugged your knees close to you and stared off into the moving ripples of the water.

you blinked once and closed your eyes to just listen to your surroundings, faint footsteps could be heard and it didn't take long for her hand to gently place themselves on your shoulder, while moving to sit beside you.
